title: Unique Coffee Table
text: Unique Coffee Table. My 24 year old son lives in our basement. He just graduated from college. With housing rates so high right now, we've told him that he can live there for the next year rent free. After that, if he still can't afford rental or purchase prices, he will have to pay us rent. He has been wanting the space down there to look more grownup. He has a couple of sofas and this table is in front of one of them. My husband assisted him in putting it together. It wasn't complicated, but they recommend not using the tool that comes with it or you'll be working on it for much longer. The finished table looks great! My son likes the lights. His basement is looking more grown up!
